summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: @ornikar/eslint-config-node@12.2.3 ships a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, downloads a Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, unpacks it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it to run a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is ~727KB of hex-obfuscated Bun-CJS bundled code (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, shuffled string-array with rotation routine) that is not otherwise referenced by the package's declared ESLint config entry points (index.js, plugins/, root.js). The alternate runtime is used to execute an opaque payload that Node-based inspection cannot easily reach, and an ESLint configuration package has no legitimate need to download a language runtime at install time. The presence of an obfuscated bundled payload alongside genuine ESLint config files is consistent with a hijacked-publish compromise of an existing package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
